bio.text: John Carson was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in an October 2011 special election runoff and represents District 46 in northeast Cobb and southeast Cherokee counties.
Carson is an Atlanta native with a BBA in accounting from Georgia State University and an MBA in finance from Kennesaw State University, and is a CPA.
Carson owns Armagh Capital and previously worked for KPMG, GE Capital and SunTrust.
